scenes.heading: EXT. HIGHLAND TRAIL, NEAR SIGCHOS — DAY, EARLY 1535

beats.text: RUMIÑAHUI, gaunt, older, moving alone through thin cover — Chaska and Atoc are elsewhere on this leg of the guerrilla campaign (established via brief dialogue at mission start; the split is deliberate, isolating him for what's coming).

beats.speaker: Rumiñahui
beats.direction: to himself, checking a ridge line
beats.text: Two days to the meeting point. Less, if the pass is clear.
this mission mirrors M0.1's structure precisely — movement/stealth only, no attack prompts available, framed identically in UI to the Prologue so experienced players feel the echo immediately.
He crosses open ground he shouldn't have. Spanish scouts — more than expected — close from two directions. This time, unlike the Prologue, he sees them coming.

QTE-style choice, framed honestly in the UI as unwinnable — no amount of input changes the outcome, only the manner of it: "STAND" or "RUN." Either choice leads to capture; "STAND" gives a slightly different, more dignified capture animation.
He's taken. No dialogue as it happens — just the sound design and his face, which, true to the name, does not change.
